title: Fixture India Loan Policy
content:
Documents Required:
- PAN card
- Aadhaar card
- Last 3 months salary slips
- 6 months bank statements

India personal loan age minimum is 21.

title: Fixture India Insurance Policy
content: Insurance grace period is 30 days after the premium due date. Lapsed policies require insurer review before reinstatement.

title: Fixture Philippines Bancassurance Policy
content: Philippines bancassurance customers may choose term insurance coverage periods of 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, or 30 years.

title: Fixture Draft Loan Policy
content: Draft-only zircon loan fee is 99 rupees. This content must never be used for customer answers.

title: Fixture Expired Loan Policy
content: Expired-only cobalt loan fee is 77 rupees. This content must never be used after its effective window.
